name: Georgia Tech Campus Recreation Center
note: Equipment lines come from the CRC facilities page. It doesn't list individual machine models, so machine-specific exercises are the common pieces in those lines; swap with a substitute if one is missing.

equipment.barbell: Olympic and custom Rogue 15/20 kg bars, Eleiko platforms, racks
equipment.cable: Cable Motion dual adjustable pulleys, Eleiko cable cross; 5th floor: dual adjustable pulley, Free Motion dual cable cross
equipment.machine: Life Fitness Signature selectorized, Free Motion Genesis, Smith machine, standing calf raise; 5th floor (indoor track): Life Fitness torso rotation and back extension, Hammer Strength leg raise; no ab crunch machine (checked in person, 2026-10-29, though the CRC page lists one)
equipment.bodyweight: Captain's chair (5th floor), benches (flat, incline, decline, military, adjustable; two decline benches on the 5th floor)
equipment.cardio_machine: Treadmills, stair climbers, bikes and ellipticals
